_comment: Record schema for the suggestion-block capture instrument (road-to-suggestion-block-capture Phase 1.3). Registered BEFORE the hook exists, so the field set is a pre-commitment rather than a description of whatever the code ended up writing. COUNTS-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: there is no field able to hold free text — no prompt, no option label, no command name beyond the evidence class. That is the discipline dispatch-economy-metrics.json:27 fixes as 'a count derived from the result object, never its content', and it is the reason a privacy review here is a schema read rather than a scrubber audit. Every budget-shaped config in this tree carries owner and review_by per the budget-ownership lint.

record_fields.ts: ISO-8601 UTC second precision. Not a duration and not a correlation key.
record_fields.block_emitted: boolean — the previous assistant turn matched the render signature.
record_fields.options_count: integer — how many numbered options the block carried. A COUNT of options, never their labels.
record_fields.evidence_class: enum: render-signature | latch-consumed | latch-stale | no-latch. WHY the classification was reachable, not what the turn said.

field_ban.rule: No record field may hold a prompt, an option label, a command name, a file path, or any other free-form string. The enums above are closed; a value outside them is a defect in the writer, not a new category.
field_ban.why_a_ban_and_not_a_scrubber: A scrubber can fail and leave content in the sink. A type with no field able to carry content cannot. Same reasoning as the telemetry engagement event, which was deliberately built with no payload/notes/extra key.
field_ban.checked_by: tests/scripts/suggestion_capture.test.ts asserts the written line's key set equals record_fields exactly, so an added field fails a test rather than shipping quietly.

option_n_note: `option_n` records THAT a numbered option was chosen and, via options_count, out of how many. It deliberately does NOT record WHICH number: the block's option order is content, and the capture-rate question this instrument exists to answer does not need it.

soak_window.why_fixed_before_the_window: A window whose length is chosen after the numbers are in is a window chosen to produce a number. Fixed here, before any capture code ran, per the same pre-registration discipline hook-latency-budget.json records for itself.
